title: Clyde River Recreation

services.name: Single Kayak
services.desc: Whether you're planning a weekend getaway or looking to shake up your summer routine, kayaking on Vermont's Clyde River belongs at the top of your list. It's not just a fun way to spend the day, it's an unforgettable experience that leaves you feeling more relaxed, more grounded, and maybe even a little more connected to nature (and your paddling partner). One of the best things about kayaking is how beginner-friendly it is. You don't need fancy gear or years of experience; just a paddle, a sense of adventure, and maybe a snack or two.
